correctness.rationale: For fixed s>0 the ellipse has constant area and its squared radial boundary in the rescaled Fock plane is b=s/(cosh(2t)-sinh(2t)cos(2θ)). Differentiating this moving radial limit gives P''00=-2s²exp(-s) and P'20=s²exp(-s)/√2, with the rest of the first-variation column zero. The fixed compact-disk pullback is trace-norm analytic and the top disk mode is isolated by s exp(-s); the h2 gap is s(s+2)exp(-s)/2. The reduced resolvent gives both stated coefficients and the plus sign of the phase-normalized h2 term. The quarter-turn yields evenness of the eigenvalue and hence the fourth-order remainder. Differentiating the loss coefficient gives the unique maximizing area. Independent polar incomplete-gamma quadrature in 18-mode sections corroborates the coefficients at four areas and three deformations; this is not the proof and gives no uniformity in area.
